name: 38024 · Dyersburg, TN
findings: ZIP 38024 (Dyersburg) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38024 (Dyersburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 38024 (Dyersburg) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).
